reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: Call for binding international AI treaty
themes.definition: Speaker calls for an international treaty, convention or binding framework to govern AI development, often likening it to nuclear safeguards.
themes.inclusion: Include passages explicitly calling for a treaty, convention, binding framework or international laws regulating AI.
themes.exclusion: Exclude general praise of cooperation on AI without any call for rules or regulation.
themes.boundary_cases: Calls for international laws specifically on military AI are coded AI_MILITARY_WEAPONS and may also be coded here if general regulation is urged.

examples.quote: today we call for an international treaty governing the development of artificial intelligence
we renew our call for a binding international framework to ensure that this technology becomes a driver of innovation rather than division

themes.label: Warning on military AI and autonomous weapons
themes.definition: Speaker warns about military applications of AI and autonomous weapons and seeks legal regulation of them.
themes.inclusion: Include explicit references to military uses of AI, autonomous weapons, or AI exacerbating armed conflict.
themes.exclusion: Exclude general references to peace or security without a military-use dimension.
themes.boundary_cases: Statements that AI should contribute to peace rather than conflict, without naming weapons, are primarily AI_GLOBAL_GOVERNANCE.

examples.quote: The Kingdom also warns of the dangers of the military uses of artificial intelligence applications and autonomous weapons.

themes.label: AI within national development and diversification
themes.definition: AI is named as part of the country's own economic vision, digital transformation, or modernization agenda, usually briefly and among other sectors.
themes.inclusion: Include passages where AI is listed as a national priority or sector the government supports or promotes.
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages where AI is discussed mainly as a global governance problem.
themes.boundary_cases: Very brief listings of AI among many domestic priorities may also warrant AI_TECH_LIST_MENTION.

examples.quote: with support for the digital economy and artificial-intelligence technologies, tourism, logistics and financial sectors
We also place high importance on digital transformation, artificial intelligence applications, innovation, industrial development
We also seek to promote digital innovation and artificial intelligence with the aim of providing a safe, stable, prosperous, and sustainable environment.

themes.label: International AI capacity-building and ethics centres
themes.definition: Speaker highlights hosting or leading international networks and centres for AI capacity building, research and ethics, linked to UN/UNESCO processes.
themes.inclusion: Include references to AI capacity-building centres, research networks, or institutions supporting other countries' AI capacity.
themes.exclusion: Exclude domestic-only AI investments with no international capacity-building role.
themes.boundary_cases: Mentions of the Pact for the Future or UNESCO as auspices may also be coded AI_UN_ROLE; ethics centres may also be AI_HUMAN_RIGHTS_ETHICS.

examples.quote: The Kingdom has taken a leading role in establishing the International Network of Artificial Intelligence Capacity Building Centres

value.rationale: Gulf state passages mix brief listings of AI within national development visions with more substantive Bahraini calls for a binding AI treaty and a Saudi warning on military AI. Saudi Arabia 2026 adds an international capacity-building and ethics angle.
